parameters.query:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_chunks (
  chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  document_name TEXT,
  page_number INTEGER,
  original_content TEXT,
  contextual_content TEXT,
  content TEXT,
  embedding vector(768),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_chunks_embedding_idx
ON document_chunks
USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lexical_documents (
  chunk_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  document_name TEXT,
  page_number INTEGER,
  content TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ settings: { analysis: { filter: { french_stop: { type: 'stop', stopwords: '_french_' }, french_stemmer: { type: 'stemmer', language: 'light_french' } }, analyzer: { rag_french: { type: 'custom', tokenizer: 'standard', filter: ['lowercase','french_stop','french_stemmer'] } } } }, mappings: { properties: { chunk_id: { type: 'keyword' }, document_id: { type: 'keyword' }, document_name: { type: 'keyword' }, page_number: { type: 'integer' }, content: { type: 'text', analyzer: 'rag_french' } } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chunk_id: $json.chunk_id, document_id: $json.document_id, document_name: $json.document_name, page_number: $json.page_number, content: $json.content || $json.original_content || '' }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO lexical_documents
(chunk_id, document_id, document_name, page_number, content)
VALUES
(
  '{{ $json.chunk_id }}',
  '{{ $json.document_id }}',
  '{{ ($json.document_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.page_number ?? 'NULL' }},
  '{{ ($json.content || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  document_id = EXCLUDED.document_id,
  document_name = EXCLUDED.document_name,
  page_number = EXCLUDED.page_number,
  content = EXCLUDED.content;

INSERT INTO document_chunks
(
  chunk_id,
  document_id,
  document_name,
  page_number,
  original_content,
  contextual_content,
  content,
  embedding
)
VALUES
(
  '{{ $json.chunk_id }}',
  '{{ $json.document_id }}',
  '{{ ($json.document_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.page_number ?? 'NULL' }},
  '{{ ($json.original_content || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '',
  '{{ ($json.content || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.embedding) }}'::vector
)
ON CONFLICT (chunk_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  document_name = EXCLUDED.document_name,
  page_number = EXCLUDED.page_number,
  original_content = EXCLUDED.original_content,
  contextual_content = EXCLUDED.contextual_content,
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding;

SELECT
  chunk_id,
  document_id,
  document_name,
  page_number,
  original_content,
  contextual_content,
  content,
  1 - (embedding <=> '{{ JSON.stringify($json.embedding) }}'::vector) AS semantic_score
FROM document_chunks
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY embedding <=> '{{ JSON.stringify($json.embedding) }}'::vector
LIMIT 30;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ size: 30, track_total_hits: false, _source: ['chunk_id','document_id','document_name','page_number','content'], query: { bool: { should: [ { match_phrase: { content: { query: $json.query, boost: 6 } } }, { match: { content: { query: $json.query, operator: 'or', boost: 3 } } }, { match: { document_name: { query: $json.query, boost: 2 } } } ], minimum_should_match: 1 } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'llama3.2:latest',
  stream: false,
  options: {
    temperature: 0
  },
  prompt:
`Tu es un assistant administratif de l'ENIB.

Tu dois répondre uniquement à partir des documents fournis dans le CONTEXTE.

QUESTION :
${$json.query}

INTENTION :
${$json.intent}

CONTEXTE :
${$json.context}

RÈGLES STRICTES :

1. Réponds directement à la question.

2. Utilise uniquement les informations présentes dans le CONTEXTE.

3. N'utilise aucune connaissance externe.

4. N'invente aucune information.

5. Ignore les informations du contexte qui ne répondent pas à la question.

6. Si la question demande un lien ou une URL, donne EXACTEMENT l'URL présente dans le CONTEXTE.

7. Ne modifie jamais une URL.

8. Si plusieurs URLs sont présentes, choisis uniquement celle qui répond à la question.

9. Si la question demande un prix, donne exactement le prix indiqué dans le document.

10. Si la question demande des horaires, donne exactement les horaires indiqués dans le document.

11. Si la question demande des règles, consignes ou obligations, donne uniquement les règles pertinentes.

12. Utilise [SOURCE X] pour indiquer la source de l'information.

13. Ne donne pas les autres informations présentes dans les documents si elles ne sont pas nécessaires pour répondre.

14. Si aucune information du CONTEXTE ne permet de répondre à la question, réponds exactement :

Je ne trouve pas cette information dans les documents fournis.

EXEMPLE :

Question :
le lien pour consulter le menu

Si le contexte contient :
https://services.imt-atlantique.fr/rak/pagemenu.php

Réponse :
Le menu du RAK est disponible ici :
https://services.imt-atlantique.fr/rak/pagemenu.php

[SOURCE 1]

Réponds maintenant à la question.`
}) }}

nodes.name: Upload PDF Webhook
nodes.notes: Accepts a multipart/form-data POST from the React frontend, field name 'data' (matches 'Extract PDF Text' below). Set 'options.allowedOrigins' to your real frontend origin in production instead of '*'. Responds immediately via 'Respond - PDF Received' while chunking/embedding continues in the background.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "processing", message: "Document received, indexing in the background.", document_id: $json.document_id || $execution.id }) }}

nodes.name: Respond - PDF Received
nodes.notes: Responds right away so the browser isn't left waiting through chunking/contextualizing/embedding, which can take a while for a large PDF. The rest of the pipeline keeps running after this responds.

nodes.name: Chat Webhook
nodes.notes: Expects JSON body { chatInput, sessionId } from the React chat panel - matches what 'Normalize Query3' already reads. Set 'options.allowedOrigins' to your real frontend origin in production instead of '*'.

nodes.name: Respond - Chat Answer
nodes.notes: Sends 'Return Answer3' output back over HTTP - this is what src/lib/api.js's sendChatMessage() reads.
